title: Pricing Memorandum — Fee-Model Lines in the Monthly Charge of the Early Termination Fee
content:
The monthly charge of the early termination fee of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement follows the agreement's fee model:

| Fee model of the agreement | Monthly charge |
|---|---|
| employer-paid | the platform fee, plus the per-worker fee lines entered on dates from which fewer than 3 whole months have passed to today, divided by 3 |
| employer-sponsored | the platform fee, plus the sponsored instant fee and sponsored next-business-day fee lines entered in that window, divided by 3 |
| worker-paid | the platform fee alone |

A whole month from a line's entry date is reached on the same day of the month as that entry date, or on the first day of the next month where that month has no such day. The lines are taken at their billed amounts.

## Illustration (hypothetical employer-paid program)

Per-worker fee lines of 2100.00, 2140.00 and 2180.00 entered within the window total 6420.00; divided by 3 they add 2140.00 to the platform fee in the monthly charge. Under the worker-paid model the same program's monthly charge would be its platform fee alone.
